vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species apis_mellifera --assembly Amel_HAv3.1 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records sit on (CM009946.2, CM009947.2 and QIUM02000090.1) at their full length from the Ensembl Metazoa release 63 files Apis_mellifera.Amel_HAv3.1.dna.primary_assembly.CM009946.2.fa.gz, Apis_mellifera.Amel_HAv3.1.dna.primary_assembly.CM009947.2.fa.gz and Apis_mellifera.Amel_HAv3.1.dna.nonchromosomal.fa.gz, each held to the directory's CHECKSUMS, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 233 records, 208 on chromosome CM009946.2 (linkage group 16), 18 on the mitochondrion CM009947.2 and 7 on the unplaced scaffold QIUM02000090.1; 22 name their sequence by a synonym of the cache's chr_synonyms.txt: four by a RefSeq accession without its version (NC_037653 and NC_001566, two each), none by the name of CM009946.2 or of CM009947.2 without its version. All are seeded records of tools/vep-seeded-variants, their IDs the generator's category and ordinal, their reference alleles read from the genome sequence. Eight exemplars per consequence-set combination the reference shows, stratified by variant class and strand, twenty-four per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name (16): two each of the mitochondrion's changed codon, start codon, gained stop and lost stop under genetic code table 5, of the organelle records, of the records named by a synonym and of the records at the first and at the last base of a sequence. The cache carries no known variants, so no record comes from a variation set. CM009947.2 translates under genetic code table 5 and every other sequence under table 1, each transcript's codon_table in the cache
